4、冬天里会唱歌的床
dong tian li hui chang ge de chuang
page_text_en:
4. A Bed That Sings in Winter
dong tian li hui chang ge de chuang
summary_zh: 本页为绘本第4页的标题页，标题为《冬天里会唱歌的床》，并附有拼音注释。

page_text_ocr_zh:
过了色彩美丽的秋天，冬天很快
就会来到。
为了在泥洞里过一个漫长的冬天，小鼹鼠得赶在寒冬到来之前在洞里藏好多好多吃的东西。

看着整天忙忙碌碌的小鼹鼠，住在小鼹鼠隔壁的刺猬说话了：“小鼹鼠，你太辛苦了，让我帮你一起寻找食物吧！”
page_text_en:
After the colorful autumn, winter will come soon.
To spend a long winter in his mud hole, the little mole must hide lots and lots of food in his hole before the cold winter arrives.

Seeing the little mole busy all day, the hedgehog living next door said, "Little mole, you're working too hard. Let me help you find food together!"
summary_zh: 本页描述了秋天结束、冬天将至，小鼹鼠为过冬储备食物，刺猬看到后主动提出帮忙寻找食物。

page_text_ocr_zh:
刺猬和小鼹鼠一起忙碌起来，他把寻找到的土豆、花生、栗子和甜枣，一股脑儿地送到小鼹鼠家的洞口。
小鼹鼠说：“这么多东西，足够我吃整整一个冬天了。刺猬，你不给自己留点吗？”
“不用。”刺猬说，“冬天我会冬眠，冬眠是不吃不喝的，用不着准备东西。”
严冬很快来了。今年的冬天特别冷，风雪也比往年大。
小鼹鼠住在暖暖的地洞里，吃着美味的东西，他一点也不用担心洞外的世界。
page_text_en:
The hedgehog and the mole were busy together. He brought the potatoes, peanuts, chestnuts, and sweet dates he had found, and dumped them all at the entrance of the mole's burrow.

The mole said, "So much food, enough for me to eat the whole winter. Hedgehog, aren't you saving any for yourself?"

"No need," the hedgehog said. "I'll hibernate in winter. Hibernation means not eating or drinking, so I don't need to prepare anything."

The harsh winter came quickly. This year's winter was especially cold, with heavier snow and wind than before.

The mole lived in his warm underground burrow, eating delicious food, and he didn't worry at all about the world outside.
summary_zh: 刺猬和小鼹鼠一起收集食物，刺猬将找到的食物全部送给小鼹鼠，自己不保留。刺猬解释自己会冬眠，不需要食物，而小鼹鼠则在温暖的洞穴中安心过冬。

page_text_ocr_zh:
刺猬呢,睡在铺着软软褥子的床上,身上盖着厚厚的被子,他也不觉得冷。

有一天,刺猬被呼啸的北风惊醒了,窗外的雪越下越大,刺猬不由得担心起来,他怕小鼹鼠在地底下会很冷,他还担心小鼹鼠洞里的东西是否够吃……

想着想着,刺猬睡不着了,他眼巴巴地瞧着天花板,觉得肚子也饿了起来。可是刺猬洞里没有一点吃的,他要到春天才能出去找吃的。

刺猬饿着想着,想着饿着,他更睡不着了。
page_text_en:
The hedgehog, sleeping on a bed with soft cushions, covered in thick blankets, didn't feel cold.

One day, the hedgehog was awakened by the howling north wind. The snow outside was falling harder and harder. The hedgehog couldn't help but worry—he was afraid the mole would be cold underground, and he also worried whether the mole had enough food in its burrow...

Thinking and thinking, the hedgehog couldn't sleep. He stared longingly at the ceiling, feeling his stomach growl with hunger. But there was no food at all in the hedgehog's burrow—he wouldn't be able to go out to find food until spring.

The hedgehog, hungry and thinking, thinking and hungry, couldn't sleep any more.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了刺猬在温暖的床上冬眠，但被北风惊醒后，他开始担心小鼹鼠的安危和食物，同时自己也因饥饿而无法入睡。

page_text_ocr_zh:
刺猬捶打着床铺说：“一个很糟糕的冬眠哪！”
这时，刺猬身下的床忽然说话了：“别担心，你会再睡着的。”
好奇怪，床怎么会说话？
刺猬对他的床说：
“我担心好朋友小鼹鼠会挨冻呢！”
床没说话，却轻轻地哼唱起来：
“北风吹，北风吹，
小鼹鼠在家吃吃又睡睡。
雪花下，雪花下，
飘不进鼹鼠温暖的家……”
这下刺猬放心了，他说：“可是这会儿我肚子咕咕叫呢！”
床又轻轻哼起了歌：
page_text_en:
The hedgehog pounded the bed and said, “What a terrible hibernation this is!”
At that moment, the bed under the hedgehog suddenly spoke: “Don’t worry, you’ll fall asleep again.”
How strange! How could the bed talk?
The hedgehog said to his bed:
“I’m worried my good friend the mole will get cold!”
The bed didn’t speak, but softly began to sing:
“North wind blows, north wind blows,
The mole is eating and sleeping at home.
Under the snowflakes, under the snowflakes,
They can’t drift into the mole’s warm home…”
Now the hedgehog felt reassured. He said, “But my stomach is rumbling!”
The bed softly began to sing again:
summary_zh: 刺猬在冬眠时被床的歌声惊醒，他担心好朋友小鼹鼠会挨冻，床则通过歌声安抚他，并告诉他小鼹鼠在温暖的家中安全过冬。刺猬虽然放心了，但因饥饿而无法入睡，床再次哼起歌来。

page_text_en:
Close your eyes,
and in a moment, open them to see—
Your bedside cabinet will have chestnuts and jujubes...

The hedgehog closed his eyes, and after a moment, opened them again.
He looked, and indeed, on his bedside cabinet were chestnuts and jujubes again.
The chestnuts were even peeled!

The hedgehog thought for a moment, then said, "This little bit of food might not be enough."

The bed said, "Please close your eyes again!"

The hedgehog had just closed his eyes when he opened them again.
He saw two tiny hands holding chestnuts and jujubes sticking out from under the bed.
The hedgehog grabbed the hands and pulled them out—it was his good friend, the little mole.

Originally, the little mole had heard the strong wind and snow outside the cave.
He was worried the hedgehog wouldn't sleep well, so he came to the hedgehog's window.
The little mole wiped the ice and snow off the window and saw the hedgehog blinking his eyes.
summary_zh: 刺猬在床的歌声中闭眼，床柜上出现食物，刺猬担心食物不够。他再次闭眼时，发现床底下伸出小手，原来是好朋友小鼹鼠。小鼹鼠因担心刺猬在风雪中睡不好，特意前来探望，他抹去窗上的冰和雪，看到刺猬正眨巴着眼睛。

The hedgehog got up, wanting to talk to the little mole,
but the little mole pressed down hard on the hedgehog and stuffed

The little mole crawled back under the bed.

summary_zh: 小鼹鼠为刺猬送去食物并帮他掖好被子，随后钻回床底。刺猬家的床开始轻声唱歌，歌词描绘了北风呼啸、雪花飘落的冬日景象，暗示春天尚未到来。

page_text_en:
Hedgehog, please close your eyes,
and sleep warmly for a while…”
Sleeping on this singing bed, the hedgehog felt warm all over, and he fell asleep again…
summary_zh: 刺猬在会唱歌的床上被安抚入睡，感到浑身暖暖的，再次呼呼睡着了。
